settings.subtitle: BFGoodrich is the brand most Calgary truck and Jeep owners ask for by name. We stock the All-Terrain T/A KO3 (the new flagship), KO2 (classic), Mud-Terrain T/A KM3, g-Force COMP-2 A/S Plus, and Advantage Control at 111 42 Ave SW. Built for trips into the Rockies and gravel east of Calgary.
settings.intro_heading: Why we recommend BFGoodrich in Calgary
settings.intro_richtext:
BFGoodrich has been making tires in America since 1870 — the country's first and oldest tire brand. Today they're owned by Michelin (since 1990), which is why the build quality and warranty handling are tier-1.

The All-Terrain T/A KO3 is the new flagship — released in 2024 — and the tire most Calgary truck owners are upgrading to. CoreGard sidewall technology resists punctures on Hwy 1A gravel near Cochrane and Ghost Lake. 3PMSF-rated for Alberta's winter-tire law and the BC mountain mandates.

The legacy KO2 is still available for owners who specifically want the proven 10+ years of field testing. For mud and serious off-road, the Mud-Terrain T/A KM3 takes the same CoreGard sidewall further with a more aggressive tread.

For sport sedans and coupes, the g-Force COMP-2 A/S Plus is the year-round performance pick. Every BFGoodrich we install gets the same balance, calibrated torque, and TPMS reset — and we price-match local Calgary competitors. Book installation or call (403) 452-4283.
settings.cta_description: Most KO2, KO3, and KM3 sizes in stock. Same-day install on confirmed bookings — price-matched against any local Calgary competitor.
settings.faq_1_q: KO3 vs KO2 — which BFGoodrich All-Terrain should I buy?
settings.faq_1_a: KO3 (2024) is the newer model with better wet grip, better winter performance (3PMSF), and longer treadwear. KO2 has 10+ years of field testing if you specifically want the proven option. Both share the CoreGard sidewall. For most new buyers, we recommend the KO3.
settings.faq_2_q: How much does a BFGoodrich KO3 cost in Calgary?
settings.faq_2_a: Pricing varies by size. Common LT light-truck sizes (LT275/65R18, LT285/70R17) run $450–$520 per tire. Half-ton truck sizes (P-metric) range $280–$390. We price-match any local Calgary competitor on the same KO3 size.
settings.faq_3_q: Are BFGoodrich tires 3PMSF rated for Alberta winter law?
settings.faq_3_a: The All-Terrain T/A KO3 (since 2024) and the Mud-Terrain T/A KM3 carry the 3PMSF symbol — both meet Alberta's winter-tire law and the BC Highway 93 / Trans-Canada Banff mandate. The g-Force COMP-2 A/S Plus and Advantage Control are summer/all-season tires without 3PMSF — pair them with a dedicated winter tire.
settings.faq_4_q: Do you do same-day install on BFGoodrich tires for trucks?
settings.faq_4_a: Big truck install needs a 60-minute slot (heavier tires, higher torque). We stock the most common LT sizes for KO2 and KO3. Booked before midday, same-day is usually fine — call (403) 452-4283 to confirm a bay before driving in.
settings.faq_5_q: Will BFGoodrich KO3 fit a stock half-ton truck?
settings.faq_5_a: Yes, in P-metric sizes (LT versions need a slight lift on most trucks). Tell us your year/make/model when booking and we'll confirm the right load-rated size — F-150, Silverado 1500, Ram 1500, Tundra all have stock-fit KO3 options.
settings.faq_6_a: BFGoodrich All-Terrain T/A KO3 carries a 50,000-mile (80,000 km) treadwear warranty. KM3 is a non-warrantied mud-terrain (industry standard for M/T tires). Both come with the BFGoodrich limited manufacturer defect warranty — claims processed through Prince Tires.
settings.calgary_richtext: BFGoodrich is the brand we install most on trucks running gravel east of Calgary and the BC mountain runs through Banff and Lake Louise. KO3 (the 3PMSF replacement for KO2) is now the gold standard for All-Terrain in Alberta — it qualifies under the BC winter-tire mandate from Oct 1 to Apr 30 on Highway 1 and 93. KM3 mud-terrain sees a lot of oilfield work. g-Force Comp-2 A/S handles Calgary's spring potholes on performance cars.
settings.awards_text: King of the Hammers off-road race title sponsor. Trusted by Baja 1000, SCORE International, and Dakar competitors.
settings.testimonial_quote: Running KO3s on my Tacoma. Took them up Highway 93 in November, no issues. They're 3PMSF for a reason.
